notes: Face and eye zones of the base hero (32x32 source coords, inclusive rects).
They drive the skin/eye/hair materials of every head: the base, the hair styles and (unless a set overrides them) the helmets.
Eye boxes include the dark lash row above the iris; blink sprites close exactly these pixels.

materials: per-pixel fixes where flax hair and skin highlights share colours (fringe strands over the forehead are hair, the pale cheek highlight is skin). Hair styles inherit these for unchanged pixels.
